target_task: Recruit at least six candidates to obtain three independent target-blind reviewers for the first 24 synthetic semantic-fidelity anchor packets.

preferred_composition: one semantics, pragmatics, discourse, or psycholinguistics reviewer
one writing, literacy, language-assessment, or qualitative-coding reviewer
panel_design.anti_capture_rule: Do not fill all three seats from one institution, one research group, one advisor lineage, or one professional subfield.
non_claims: No listed organization or person has agreed to participate.
Public membership, faculty, or staff status does not imply availability, independence, or qualification for this tranche.
The registry contains sourcing routes, not reviewer assignments.

sources.name: Arizona State University Quantitative Research Methods faculty
sources.evidence: ASU describes the program as advanced training in statistical modeling, measurement, research design, evaluation, and reproducibility.
sources.outreach_route: Use the official program or faculty directory to identify one faculty member or advanced doctoral researcher with measurement-model or assessment-design experience.
sources.selection_filter: Prefer evidence of measurement theory, model checking, assessment design, inter-rater reliability, or scale validation.
risk_flags: local-network familiarity with Bryan or Qira
possible prior exposure through ASU outreach

sources.name: ASU Linguistics and Applied Linguistics program
sources.evidence: The program explicitly covers semantics, pragmatics, discourse analysis, syntax, language learning, and research methods.
sources.outreach_route: Use the official program and faculty pages to identify one faculty member, postdoctoral researcher, or advanced doctoral candidate whose work concerns meaning, discourse, pragmatics, or language assessment.
sources.selection_filter: Prefer researchers who can separate propositional meaning, relationship structure, tone, audience inference, and surface fluency.
risk_flags: same-institution dependence if combined with SRC-01
construct expertise may not imply rating-design expertise

sources.name: Psychometric Society
sources.evidence: The Society is devoted to quantitative measurement practices in psychology, education, and the social sciences and provides member, committee, conference, and editorial communities.
sources.outreach_route: Request permission from the Society or use publicly listed professional channels to circulate a fixed-compensation, independent instrument-review opportunity; do not scrape or mass-message members.
sources.selection_filter: Prefer early-career or established psychometricians with rating-scale, rater-effect, generalizability, item-response, or assessment-design experience.
risk_flags: high-demand experts may require higher compensation

sources.name: AERA Writing and Literacies SIG
sources.evidence: The SIG reports more than 500 members and explicitly covers writing development, literacy research, methodology, pedagogy, and assessment across contexts.
sources.outreach_route: Ask the SIG leadership whether a neutral recruitment notice may be shared through an approved newsletter, social channel, or member route.
sources.selection_filter: Prefer researchers with writing assessment, discourse analysis, rubric development, qualitative coding, or literacy measurement experience rather than purely pedagogical interests.
risk_flags: writing-quality expertise may encourage polish substitution
large interdisciplinary pool requires strict screening

sources.name: Cognitive Science Society
sources.evidence: The Society spans linguistics, psychology, education, philosophy, neuroscience, anthropology, and AI and maintains member, mentorship, outreach, and listserv channels.
sources.outreach_route: Seek an approved listserv or outreach posting targeted to researchers in language comprehension, psycholinguistics, communication, or measurement.
sources.selection_filter: Prefer candidates with experimental work on meaning representation, language comprehension, communication, or judgment rather than AI-consciousness advocacy.
risk_flags: possible prior exposure to adjacent AI-consciousness debates
broad membership requires careful role screening

sources.name: University of Michigan syntax and semantics research community
sources.evidence: The official page lists faculty and doctoral researchers working in formal semantics, pragmatics, discourse, psycholinguistics, neurolinguistics, and computational semantics.
sources.outreach_route: Use the departmental contact or public faculty and graduate researcher pages to send a limited, role-matched invitation to one or two candidates.
sources.selection_filter: Prefer researchers capable of distinguishing preserved meaning from lexical overlap and identifying changed causal, temporal, logical, or evaluative relations.
risk_flags: formal-semantic expertise may overemphasize propositional content
individual outreach must avoid target leakage

sources.name: ETS Foundational Psychometric and Statistical Research Center
sources.evidence: ETS identifies the center's work in item response theory, differential item functioning, linking, equating, test security, process data, and large-scale assessment methods.
sources.outreach_route: Use an official research or assessment-services inquiry to ask whether an independent researcher may be referred for a small compensated instrument-development review.
sources.selection_filter: Prefer experience with constructed-response scoring, rater effects, scoring rubrics, validity arguments, or assessment design.
risk_flags: commercial consulting rates may exceed pilot budget

sources.name: ASU measurement and statistics expertise directory
sources.evidence: The directory identifies ASU researchers in measurement and statistics in education, including psychometrics, assessment, mixed models, testing, and language-literacy research.
sources.outreach_route: Use only as a secondary local sourcing route after checking overlap with SRC-01; contact a maximum of two role-matched candidates.
sources.selection_filter: Select for actual measurement or rating expertise and exclude candidates with prior project exposure or dependent relationships.
risk_flags: local convenience could undermine panel independence

candidate_selection_sequence: Source two measurement candidates from different organizations.
Source two semantics, pragmatics, discourse, or psycholinguistics candidates from different organizations.
Source two writing, literacy-assessment, or qualitative-coding candidates from different organizations.
Screen all six under the existing governance packet before discussing queue content.
Select three reviewers spanning all three disciplinary lanes and at least two institutions.
Retain at least one screened alternate until all three submissions are locked.
stop_conditions: Fewer than three independent disciplinary lanes remain represented after exclusions.
Any candidate receives constructor targets, rationales, pair labels, or another reviewer's answers.
Compensation or review window changes after the first candidate accepts.
A candidate-source organization requires outcome control, editorial approval of results, or access to protected mappings.
